rationale: The only implementation delta is the image argument passed to AcquireQuantumInfo: the vulnerable version uses image, while the fixed version uses next_image. The Logic section does not mention quantum-info initialization, its source image, buffer sizing, or any equivalent detail. Its statements about monochrome handling, row iteration, pixel export, compression, blob writing, memory/error handling, and returning bytes written are either true of both versions or sufficiently abstract to be silent on the changed argument.
